items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public officers law, in relation to the residency requirement for the assistant court clerk for the town of Somers in the county of Westchester
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5676

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the public officers law, in relation
to the residency requirement for the assistant court clerk for the
town of Somers in the county of Westchester

 PURPOSE :

This bill would exempt the assistant court clerk for the town of
Somers in the County of Westchester from the residency requirement.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section one amends section 3 of the public officers law by adding a
new subdivision 66 which states that in the town of Somers, in the
county of Westchester, the provisions of this section requiring a
person to be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal
corporation of the state for which he or she shall be chosen or within
which his or her official functions are required to be exercised,
shall not prevent a person from holding the office of assistant court
clerk of the town of Somers, provided that such person resides in the
county in which such town is located or Putnam County. Provided,
however, the person performing the functions of assistant court clerk
in any other town shall be a resident of such town, unless otherwise
provided by an act of the state legislature.

Section two establishes the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Under current law, the assistant court clerk in the town of Somers is
required to reside within the town as a condition of his or her
position. This bill, requested by the town, would allow the assistant
court clerk to reside outside of the town of Somers so long as he or
she resides in the county in which the town is located or Putnam
County.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New Bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the State.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
